name: Kilira's Descent
summary:
Kilira Cooper wakes up trapped in an old, abandoned hospital, with no idea how she got there. She quickly realizes the place is much more than just an empty building: voices echo, doors close by themselves, and disturbing visions haunt every room.

Her only goal: ESCAPE.

But the hospital seems intent on holding her back. Every step toward the exit reveals new mysteries, blurred memories... and hostile entities ready to prevent her from escaping.
